meta.philosophy: Listens for expert_rule changes via webhook (triggered by pg_notify or Supabase webhook). Propagates changes: fetches instruction payload, generates ALL IDE instruction files (copilot, agents, claude, cursorrules, windsurfrules, aisha-agent, codex-skill), commits to GitHub (one multi-file commit), notifies MCP clients, logs to Langfuse.
meta.selfDesignHint: Aisha: This workflow closes the loop between DB rule edits and ALL downstream IDE consumers. It ensures every IDE instruction file stays in sync with expert_rules via the adapter registry pattern.
